name: Eidon Tracker POV
tagline: 1,274 h of head-cam household chores from 27 contributors, paired with 7-point IMU arm tracking; CC-BY-4.0 final release.

annotations.coverageNote: Every recording carries a task label, QC status and QC metrics; VLM object tags on a subset; no temporal segments or keypoints.

action_labels.note: One task_type per recording (9 household activities; 67.5% folding_laundry)

hand_pose.note: Hand presence ratio from MediaPipe is a QC metric only

body_pose.note: 7-point IMU orientation (hands, forearms, shoulders, chest) at 24 Hz; no keypoints

qa_language.note: objects_detected VLM tags on a subset of recordings
